    /* ===== IDENTIDADE VISUAL: EDITE AS CORES AQUI ===== */

<script>
(async () => {
  const resultsSection = document.getElementById('resultados');

  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {

  }
  const viewport = document.querySelector('.results-window');
  const group = viewport.querySelector('.results-group');
  const controls = viewport.nextElementSibling;
  const [previous, next] = controls.querySelectorAll('button');
  function shuffle(cards) {
    for (let i = cards.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [cards[i], cards[j]] = [cards[j], cards[i]];
    }
    return cards;
  }
  function syncVideo() {
    const active = group.children[1] || group.firstElementChild;
    for (const video of group.querySelectorAll('video')) {
      if (active?.contains(video) && !document.hidden && inView) {
        video.muted = true;
        video.play().catch(() => {});
      } else video.pause();
    }
  }
  let inView = !('IntersectionObserver' in window);
  if (!inView) new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
    inView = entry.isIntersecting;
    syncVideo();
  }).observe(viewport);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', syncVideo);
  function prepareGallery(cards = Array.from(group.children), selected) {
    const buckets = ['corporal', 'rosto', 'labios', 'geral'].map(type =>
      shuffle(cards.filter(card => card.dataset.category === type))
    );
    const ordered = [];
    while (buckets.some(bucket => bucket.length)) {
      for (const bucket of buckets) if (bucket.length) ordered.push(bucket.pop());
    }
    if (ordered.length > 1) ordered.push(ordered.shift());
    ordered.splice(3, 0, ...cards.filter(card => card.dataset.category === 'video'));
    const selectedIndex = ordered.indexOf(selected);
    if (selectedIndex > 0) ordered.push(...ordered.splice(0, selectedIndex));
    group.replaceChildren(...ordered);
    group.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(photo => { photo.loading = 'eager'; });
    const hasNeighbor = group.children.length > 1;
    if (hasNeighbor) group.prepend(group.lastElementChild);
    viewport.classList.toggle('has-neighbor', hasNeighbor);

      if (group.animate && !matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {

        const animation = group.animate(

          { duration: 380, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.25,1)' }
        );

  let touchStart;

  });
  viewport.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => { touchStart = null; });
  viewport.addEventListener('pointerup', event => {
    if (!touchStart || !event.isPrimary) return;
    const dx = event.clientX - touchStart.x;
